plain_english_revision: The amendment changes the bill by adding specific provisions for Alabama State University's Board of Trustees regarding meeting schedules, special/emergency meeting procedures, and rules for remote participation via telephone or video conference.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment supports adding specific provisions that allow the Board of Trustees of Alabama State University to conduct meetings remotely (via phone/video) under certain conditions, establish regular meeting schedules for May and November, define procedures for calling special or emergency meetings with notice periods ranging from 72 hours to 10 days depending on urgency, and ensure public access to observe these remote meetings in compliance with the Open Meetings Act.
evidence_quotes: On page 1, after line 14 insert the following language: Existing law provides for semi-annual meetings of the Board of Trustees of Alabama State University. This bill would authorize the board to conduct meetings of the board... by telephone or video conference...

Relating to university boards of trustees; to authorize the Board of Trustees of the University of West Alabama to allow participation in certain meetings by telephone or video conference, or by similar means under certain conditions; and to authorize the Board of Trustees of Alabama State University to hold certain meetings by telephone or video conference...
Members of the board may participate in a meeting of the board or any committee of the board by means of telephone conference, video conference, or similar communications equipment...

However, a A majority of a quorum of the members of the board... shall not be required to be physically present at the location noticed and called for the meeting in order to conduct any business or deliberation.
Notice of an emergency meeting shall be given at least 72 hours before the time the emergency meeting is to commence unless the circumstances of the emergency require the meeting to convene sooner.
